title: Gross GST Collections Surge 15.4% to ₹2.11 Trillion in July 2026
summary: GST collections serve as India's primary high-frequency indicator of indirect tax efficiency and macroeconomic health.

blocks.content: GST collections serve as India's primary high-frequency indicator of indirect tax efficiency and macroeconomic health.

items: Growth was driven primarily by higher mop-up from **domestic transactions** as well as **import of goods**.
Represents one of the highest monthly gross GST collection figures recorded.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: GST introduced July 1, 2017 via 101st Constitutional Amendment Act, 2016 (Article 279A).

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: Do not confuse Gross GST collection (before refunds) with Net GST collection (tax retained post-refunds).
